vedic.text: Mars is in the 6th house (Ripu bhav) in Capricorn. This house covers enemies, disease, debts, disputes, litigation, service, daily work. It is a dusthana (6/8/12) – houses of struggle; planets here face obstacles or turn their energy to fighting problems; also an upachaya (3/6/10/11) – houses of growth; malefics improve here with time and effort. Mars is exalted – at its strongest, gives its best results. For your Leo ascendant it rules houses 4 & 9 (mother; fortune), so those matters are carried into the 6th house. It is yogakaraka (rules both an angle and a trine) – the best planet for this ascendant. Conjunct (yuti) with Ketu. Aspected by Jupiter, Rahu. It aspects houses 1, 9, 12. Nakshatra Uttara Ashadha (pada 3, ruled by Sun).

Do not perform multiple major remedies simultaneously; maintain consistency with one remedy for the prescribed duration (e.g. 40 or 43 days).

source: Lal Kitab (Arun Sanhita), Hare Krishna Trust edition

1.name: Tanu bhav
1.meaning: self, body, health, personality, overall direction of life

2.name: Dhana bhav
2.meaning: wealth, savings, family, speech, food, early education

3.name: Sahaja bhav
3.meaning: courage, effort, younger siblings, communication, short travel, skills with the hands

4.name: Sukha bhav
4.meaning: mother, home, property, vehicles, inner peace, schooling

5.name: Putra bhav
5.meaning: children, intelligence, learning, mantra, creativity, past-life merit, speculation

6.name: Ripu bhav
6.meaning: enemies, disease, debts, disputes, litigation, service, daily work

7.name: Kalatra bhav
7.meaning: marriage, spouse, partnerships, business dealings, public

8.name: Ayu bhav
8.meaning: longevity, sudden events, hidden matters, inheritance, research, chronic illness, the occult

9.name: Dharma bhav
9.meaning: fortune, father, guru, dharma, higher learning, long journeys, blessings

10.name: Karma bhav
10.meaning: career, status, authority, actions in the world, reputation

11.name: Labha bhav
11.meaning: gains, income, fulfilment of desires, elder siblings, friends, networks

12.name: Vyaya bhav
12.meaning: expenses, losses, sleep, foreign lands, hospitals, isolation, moksha
